title: A document written with WordprocessingML as its default namespace cannot be edited
symptom: a document whose main part writes its elements without a prefix (`<document xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main">`) opens, reads and saves unchanged, but every edit is refused with "cannot serialize a modified document with a shadowed `default` namespace"
workaround: open and save the document in Word or LibreOffice, which write the `w:` prefix, then edit the saved copy
